identity.summary: Existing approved masters and proof bytes remain unchanged. Local Media Gallery 1.0.0 is a new, separately approved Jade identity with photo and video cutouts.

palette.summary: Existing palette values and WCAG 2.1 AA rules remain unchanged.

typography.summary: Approved local font families, faces, and licenses remain unchanged.

platform_assets.summary: Regenerate to adopt optional source-owned horizontal wordmark rows, centered-group slogan-only social images, and corrected long-name/compound type specimens. Existing default logo layouts and approved social images remain unchanged.

web_react.summary: Web and React adapter APIs and interface token behavior remain unchanged.

egui.summary: The egui adapter API and output semantics remain unchanged.

wordpress.summary: WordPress adapter 1.0.0 retains its public contract and supports the compatible Brand Canon 2.1.0 tuple.

documentation.summary: Publish Local Media Gallery guidelines, approved exact messages, registries and downloads through standard generated routes. Brand Canon 2.1.0 adds optional lockup layout and social composition fields; earlier conforming inputs remain supported.

recovery.summary: Repinning BrandBuilder 3.1.0 requires its exact new package IDs and checksums. The verified site hosts thirteen brands; ten owned archives join the skill and portable distribution, while three client kits remain hosted candidates. Previously published packages remain immutable recovery inputs.
